title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A1–B1）
section: 第 951–1,000 個單字（CEFR A1 基礎入門）

examples.en: I hope to see you again during the winter vacation!
examples.zh: 希望寒假能再次見到你！

examples.en: We hope for good weather so we can go camping this weekend.
examples.zh: 我們期盼好天氣，這樣週末才能去露營。

examples.en: Never lose hope, even when facing difficult times.
examples.zh: 即使面對艱難困境，也絕不要失去希望。

examples.en: Make a wish before blowing out the birthday candles.
examples.zh: 吹熄生日蠟燭前許個願吧。

examples.en: I wish you the best of luck on your college entrance exam!
examples.zh: 祝你在大學聯考中一切好運順利！

examples.en: Send our warm wishes to your parents when you visit home.
examples.zh: 你回家探親時代我們向你的雙親致上溫馨的祝福。

examples.en: Good friends trust each other completely.
examples.zh: 好朋友之間會彼此完全信任。

examples.en: Mutual trust is the solid foundation of any strong relationship.
examples.zh: 相互信任是任何穩固人際關係的堅實基石。

examples.en: Can I trust you to keep this secret safe between us?
examples.zh: 我能信任你替我們兩人保守這個秘密嗎？

examples.en: I have no doubt that you will pass the English test.
examples.zh: 我毫不懷疑你一定會通過英語測驗。

examples.en: When in doubt, always ask your teacher for guidance.
examples.zh: 遇到疑惑時，務必向老師尋求指引。

examples.en: There is little doubt that renewable solar energy will power our future.
examples.zh: 毫無疑問，再生太陽能將驅動我們的未來世界。

examples.en: Always believe in yourself and your abilities.
examples.zh: 永遠要相信你自己和你的能力。

examples.en: Believe it or not, she learned to speak fluent Spanish in just six months.
examples.zh: 信不信由你，她僅僅花了六個月就學會了說一口流利的西班牙語。

examples.en: Scientists believe that regular physical exercise improves cognitive brain function.
examples.zh: 科學家們相信規律的身體運動能增進大腦認知功能。

examples.en: I wonder what the weather will be like tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我想知道明天的天氣會是如何。

examples.en: Taroko Gorge is recognized as a magnificent natural wonder of Taiwan.
examples.zh: 太魯閣峽谷被公認為台灣壯麗絕倫的大自然奇蹟。

examples.en: It is no wonder she won the speech championship; she practiced diligently every day.
examples.zh: 難怪她會奪得演講冠軍，她每天都無比勤勉地練習。

examples.en: I suppose it is going to rain soon; look at the dark clouds.
examples.zh: 我猜快要下雨了，看看那些烏雲。

examples.en: We are supposed to submit our project assignments before Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 我們理應在週五下午前繳交專案作業。

examples.en: What do you suppose is the most effective method for memorizing new words?
examples.zh: 你認為記憶新單字最有效的方法是什麼？

examples.en: Guess what? We are going to Kenting this weekend!
examples.zh: 你猜怎麼著？我們這週末要去墾丁！

examples.en: Can you guess how old this ancient banyan tree is?
examples.zh: 你能猜得出這棵古老榕樹有多少歲了嗎？

examples.en: That was a very close guess, but the real answer is forty-two.
examples.zh: 那是一個非常接近的猜測，但真正的答案是四十二。

examples.en: We expect a sunny day for our school field trip.
examples.zh: 我們期盼校外教學當天是個大晴天。

examples.en: As expected, our school basketball team advanced to the finals easily.
examples.zh: 不出所料，我們學校的籃球隊輕鬆晉級了決賽。

examples.en: Parents expect their children to do their best and stay honest.
examples.zh: 父母期許孩子們全力以赴並常保誠實正直。

examples.en: She gladly accepted the invitation to the birthday party.
examples.zh: 她欣然接受了參加生日派對的邀請。

examples.en: The university accepted his application for the master's degree program.
examples.zh: 這所大學錄取了他攻讀碩士學位學程的入學申請。

examples.en: Learning to accept constructive criticism helps you grow professionally.
examples.zh: 學會接納建設性的批評能幫助你在職場上不斷成長。

examples.en: He politely refused the extra piece of chocolate cake.
examples.zh: 他禮貌地婉拒了額外的巧克力蛋糕。

examples.en: The brave firefighter refused to give up searching for survivors.
examples.zh: 英勇的消防員拒絕放棄搜救任何生還者。

examples.en: It is perfectly fine to refuse requests that compromise your personal values.
examples.zh: 拒絕違背自己個人原則與價值觀的請求是完全合理的。

examples.en: We decided to take the High Speed Rail to Chiayi.
examples.zh: 我們決定搭乘高鐵前往嘉義。

examples.en: Take your time to carefully decide which career path suits you best.
examples.zh: 從容且審慎地決定哪條職業道路最適合你。

examples.en: The judges will decide the winner of the national speech contest tonight.
examples.zh: 評審團將在今晚決定這場全國演講比賽的優勝者。

examples.en: Getting enough exercise is a healthy life decision.
examples.zh: 保持充足運動是一項有益健康的生活決定。

examples.en: Making a major career decision requires weighing pros and cons thoroughly.
examples.zh: 做出重大的職涯抉擇需要周詳權衡各項利弊得失。

examples.en: We respect your thoughtful decision to pursue further studies overseas.
examples.zh: 我們由衷尊重你前往海外深造進修的深思熟慮決定。

examples.en: She changed her mind and ordered bubble green tea.
examples.zh: 她改變了心意，改點了珍珠綠茶。

examples.en: You can always change your mind before signing the final rental agreement.
examples.zh: 在簽署最終租賃合約之前，你隨時都可以改變心意。

examples.en: After hearing the convincing evidence, he completely changed his mind.
examples.zh: 在聽完令人信服的證據後，他徹底改變了原有的想法。

examples.en: I completely agree with your study schedule proposal.
examples.zh: 我完全同意你的讀書計畫提議。

examples.en: Spicy food does not always agree with everyone's digestive system.
examples.zh: 辛辣重口味的食物並不一定適合每個人的腸胃消化系統。

examples.en: Does your team leader agree with the proposed new project deadlines?
examples.zh: 你們的專案負責人同意所提議的新截止日期嗎？

examples.en: Our weekend picnic will depend on the weather forecast.
examples.zh: 我們週末的野餐將視天氣預報而定。

examples.en: Young children depend heavily on their parents for care and security.
examples.zh: 年幼孩童在照料與安全感方面極為依賴父母。

examples.en: You can always depend on true friends to support you through hardships.
examples.zh: 你永遠可以信賴真正的朋友陪伴你度過人生的艱難時刻。

examples.en: Does this colorful pencil case belong to you?
examples.zh: 這個色彩繽紛的鉛筆盒是你的嗎？

examples.en: These precious cultural artifacts belong to national history archives.
examples.zh: 這些珍貴的文化歷史文物歸屬於國家歷史檔案庫。

examples.en: She felt a profound sense of peace as if she belonged to nature.
examples.zh: 她感受到一種深層的心靈平靜，彷彿自己真正屬於大自然。

examples.en: What happened to your bicycle tire?
examples.zh: 你的腳踏車輪胎發生了什麼事？

examples.en: Accidents happen when people drive carelessly on wet slippery roads.
examples.zh: 當人們在濕滑路面上粗心駕駛時，交通事故便容易發生。

examples.en: It just so happened that we both booked seats on the same morning train.
examples.zh: 恰巧巧合的是，我們兩人都預訂了同一班晨間列車的座位。

examples.en: The school sports day will take place next Friday.
examples.zh: 學校運動會將於下週五舉行。

examples.en: The historic international summit took place in the grand conference hall.
examples.zh: 這場歷史性的國際高峰會在大會議廳內盛大舉行。

examples.en: Profound social and technological changes took place during the last decade.
examples.zh: 在過去十年間，發生了深刻的社會與科技變革。

examples.en: It doesn't matter; mistakes help us learn.
examples.zh: 沒關係要緊，錯誤能幫助我們學習。

examples.en: What is the matter with your computer screen? It keeps flickering.
examples.zh: 你的電腦螢幕怎麼了？它一直閃爍不停。

examples.en: Every small daily effort matters in protecting the environment.
examples.zh: 在保護生態環境方面，每個人日常的一點一滴努力都至關重要。

examples.en: Do you mind if I open the window for fresh air?
examples.zh: 你介意我打開窗戶通風嗎？

examples.en: Keep in mind that consistent review is key to mastering vocabulary.
examples.zh: 請牢記在心：持續溫習是牢記掌握單字的關鍵所在。

examples.en: A calm and peaceful mind helps you make rational, wise choices.
examples.zh: 平靜沉著的心智有助於你做出理性明智的抉擇。

examples.en: Never mind! We can easily try again tomorrow.
examples.zh: 沒關係！我們明天可以輕鬆再試一次。

examples.en: Never mind the minor delay; we will still arrive ahead of schedule.
examples.zh: 別在意這點微小的延誤，我們依然會比預定時間提前抵達。

examples.en: Oh, never mind; I just realized I already found my sunglasses in my bag.
examples.zh: 喔，沒關係了，我剛剛才發現我的太陽眼鏡就在背包裡。

examples.en: Cheer up! Everything will turn out great in the end.
examples.zh: 振作起來！最後一切都會好起來的。

examples.en: A warm cup of hot chocolate helped cheer her up on the rainy afternoon.
examples.zh: 一杯溫熱的熱巧克力幫助她在下雨的午後振作起精神開朗起來。

examples.en: We brought humorous comic books to cheer up our sick classmate in hospital.
examples.zh: 我們帶了幽默詼諧的漫畫書去醫院探望並為生病的同學打氣。

examples.en: Take three deep breaths to help yourself calm down.
examples.zh: 深呼吸三次以幫助自己冷靜下來。

examples.en: Please calm down and explain clearly what just took place.
examples.zh: 請冷靜下來，並清楚說明剛剛究竟發生了什麼事情。

examples.en: The gentle ocean breeze helped calm down his racing, anxious thoughts.
examples.zh: 溫柔的海風吹拂，撫平了他原本急促焦慮的思緒。

examples.en: Hurry up, or we will miss the MRT train!
examples.zh: 快一點，不然我們要錯過捷運列車了！

examples.en: Tell him to hurry up because the movie starts in five minutes.
examples.zh: 叫他動作快點，因為電影再過五分鐘就要開演了。

examples.en: We had to hurry up packing our bags before the airport shuttle arrived.
examples.zh: 我們必須在機場接駁專車抵達前趕緊打包好行李。

examples.en: Please slow down when driving through school zones.
examples.zh: 開車經過學校路段時請減速慢行。

examples.en: Slow down your speaking pace so non-native listeners can understand easily.
examples.zh: 放慢你的講話語速，這樣非母語聽眾才能輕鬆理解。

examples.en: Weekends provide a precious chance to slow down and savor life.
examples.zh: 週末提供了一個放慢腳步、細細品味人生的珍貴契機。

examples.en: Watch out! A scooter is coming around the corner.
examples.zh: 當心！有輛機車正從轉角過來。

examples.en: Watch out for wet, slippery steps after the heavy rainstorm.
examples.zh: 暴雨過後請當心走在潮濕濕滑的台階上。

examples.en: Hikers must watch out for steep loose rocks along the ridge trail.
examples.zh: 登山者沿著山脊步道行走時必須當心陡峭鬆動的岩石。

examples.en: Hold on a second, let me grab a pen.
examples.zh: 稍等一秒鐘，讓我拿支筆。

examples.en: Hold on tight to the safety rail while riding the roller coaster.
examples.zh: 搭乘雲霄飛車時，請牢牢緊握安全扶手。

examples.en: Hold on to your dreams even when circumstances feel discouraging.
examples.zh: 即使環境令人氣餒沮喪，也請緊握並堅持你的夢想。

examples.en: Teenagers love to hang out at Ximending on weekends.
examples.zh: 青少年週末喜歡在西門町逛街聚會。

examples.en: Let's hang out at the cozy neighborhood coffee shop this Sunday.
examples.zh: 我們這週日去社區那家溫馨的咖啡館聚聚放鬆吧。

examples.en: She enjoys hanging out with friends who share her passion for photography.
examples.zh: 她喜歡與同樣熱愛攝影的朋友們聚在一起交流交流。

examples.en: Never give up on learning and speaking English.
examples.zh: 絕不要放棄學習和開口說英語。

examples.en: When the hiking trail became steep and rocky, he refused to give up.
examples.zh: 當登山路徑變得陡峭嶙峋時，他依然拒絕輕易認輸放棄。

examples.en: Quitting smoking requires determination, but you should never give up trying.
examples.zh: 戒菸需要莫大的毅力，但你絕不要放棄不斷嘗試。

examples.en: You are doing great; keep going until the finish line!
examples.zh: 你表現得很棒，堅持下去直到終點線！

examples.en: Despite fatigue and sore muscles, the marathon runner kept going steadily.
examples.zh: 儘管身體疲憊且肌肉痠痛，馬拉松跑者依然步伐堅定地持續向前邁進。

examples.en: Life has challenges, but we must stay positive and keep going forward.
examples.zh: 人生充滿挑戰，但我們必須保持樂觀並堅定地向前邁進。

examples.en: I work out at the school gym three times a week.
examples.zh: 我每週在學校體育館健身三次。

examples.en: Don't worry; everything will work out perfectly in the end.
examples.zh: 別擔心，最後所有事情都會圓滿迎刃而解的。

examples.en: The mathematicians worked out the complex formula after hours of collaboration.
examples.zh: 數學家們經過數小時的合作推導，終於解出了那道複雜的公式。

examples.en: Together we can figure out the solution to this math problem.
examples.zh: 我們一起就能想出這道數學題的解法。

examples.en: It took me a while to figure out how to operate the new digital camera.
examples.zh: 我花了一點時間才搞清楚該如何操作這台新的數位相機。

examples.en: Scientists are working hard to figure out the mysteries of deep ocean currents.
examples.zh: 科學家們正努力解開深海洋流運行的奧秘。

examples.en: Check online to find out the train timetable.
examples.zh: 上網查詢以查明火車時刻表。

examples.en: We need to find out who organized this wonderful surprise celebration.
examples.zh: 我們需要查明究竟是誰籌辦了這場如此美好的驚喜慶祝活動。

examples.en: Read historical archives to find out more about the island's rich past.
examples.zh: 查閱歷史文獻檔案以深入發掘這座島嶼豐富悠久的昔日風華。

examples.en: I am looking for my English vocabulary flashcards.
examples.zh: 我正在尋找我的英文單字字卡。

examples.en: University graduates are actively looking for rewarding career opportunities.
examples.zh: 大學畢業生正積極尋找能發揮所長且具回報的職涯機會。

examples.en: Tourists wandered through the morning market looking for authentic local delicacies.
examples.zh: 遊客們漫步在早市中尋覓最道地的在地風味小吃。

examples.en: Look up unfamiliar words in the English-Chinese dictionary.
examples.zh: 在英漢字典中查閱不熟悉的單字。

examples.en: Look up at the night sky and you can see the glowing Milky Way.
examples.zh: 抬頭仰望夜空，你便能看見璀璨閃爍的銀河。

examples.en: Business conditions for local tourism are finally starting to look up.
examples.zh: 當地觀光旅遊業的營商景氣終於開始顯現好轉起色。

examples.en: Turn around and look at the magnificent mountain view!
examples.zh: 轉過身來欣賞壯麗的山景吧！

examples.en: The company introduced bold new strategies to turn around its falling profits.
examples.zh: 該公司推行了大膽的新策略以扭轉持續下滑的獲利頹勢。

examples.en: Walk two blocks down the street and turn around at the red brick building.
examples.zh: 沿著街道走兩個街區，在紅磚大樓處轉身回頭。

examples.en: Go ahead and ask your question; teacher is listening.
examples.zh: 請便發問你的問題，老師正在聽。

examples.en: If everyone is ready, let's go ahead with the scheduled meeting.
examples.zh: 如果大家都準備就緒了，我們就按照排定議程著手進行會議吧。

examples.en: The city gave the green light to go ahead with the public library expansion project.
examples.zh: 市政府對公共圖書館擴建工程亮起綠燈批准進行。

examples.en: Come on! You can finish the final lap of the run.
examples.zh: 加油！你能跑完最後一圈的。

examples.en: Oh, come on, don't be so hard on yourself for a tiny slip.
examples.zh: 哎，得了吧，別因為一點微不足道的小失誤就對自己如此苛刻。

examples.en: Come on inside where it's warm; dinner is served on the table.
examples.zh: 快進到屋裡暖和暖和，熱騰騰的晚餐已經端上桌了。

examples.en: Thank you for helping me. — No problem!
examples.zh: 謝謝你幫我。— 沒問題（不客氣）！

examples.en: Can you give me a ride to the subway station? — No problem at all!
examples.zh: 你能順路載我到捷運站嗎？— 完全沒問題！

examples.en: Solving this simple software glitch is no problem for our IT specialist.
examples.zh: 修復這個簡單的軟體小問題對我們的資訊專員來說易如反掌。

examples.en: May I borrow your red pen? — Of course!
examples.zh: 我能借你的紅筆嗎？— 當然可以！

examples.en: Of course we will support you in pursuing your artistic dreams.
examples.zh: 我們理所當然會全力支持你追求藝術夢想。

examples.en: Are you tired after the long hike? — Of course not, I feel completely energized!
examples.zh: 長途健行後你累了嗎？— 當然不累，我感到精力充沛！

examples.en: By the way, what time does tomorrow's meeting start?
examples.zh: 順便問一下，明天的會議幾點開始？

examples.en: By the way, congratulations on winning first prize in the speech contest!
examples.zh: 對了順便一提，恭喜你在演講比賽中榮獲第一名！

examples.en: I ran into David yesterday; by the way, he sends his warmest regards.
examples.zh: 我昨天碰見大衛了，對了他向你轉達最誠摯的問候。

examples.en: Taiwan has many high mountains, for example, Jade Mountain.
examples.zh: 台灣有許多高山，例如玉山。

examples.en: Citrus fruits, for example oranges and lemons, are rich in vitamin C.
examples.zh: 柑橘類水果，例如柳橙和檸檬，富含豐富的維生素 C。

examples.en: Many apps improve productivity; for example, digital flashcards make vocabulary learning fun.
examples.zh: 許多應用程式能提升效率，例如數位字卡讓單字學習變得趣味盎然。

examples.en: She speaks fluent English, and Japanese as well.
examples.zh: 她能說流利的英語，日語也同樣流利。

examples.en: Eating balanced meals is important, and regular exercise matters as well.
examples.zh: 均衡飲食非常重要，而規律運動也同樣不可或缺。

examples.en: If you are ordering a coffee, please get one for me as well.
examples.zh: 如果你要去點咖啡，請順便也幫我買一杯吧。

examples.en: In fact, Taiwan is the birthplace of global bubble tea.
examples.zh: 事實上，台灣是全球珍珠奶茶的發源地。

examples.en: I thought the exam would be easy, but in fact it was quite demanding.
examples.zh: 我原以為測驗會很簡單，但事實上相當具有挑戰性。

examples.en: In fact, learning a new language rewires and strengthens brain neural connections.
examples.zh: 事實上，學習新語言能重塑並強化大腦的神經連結網絡。

examples.en: You should drink at least two liters of water a day.
examples.zh: 你每天應該喝至少兩公升的水。

examples.en: Brush your teeth at least twice daily to maintain optimal dental hygiene.
examples.zh: 每天至少刷牙兩次以維持最佳的口腔衛生清潔。

examples.en: It will take at least thirty minutes to drive to the airport during morning traffic.
examples.zh: 晨間尖峰車潮期間，開車前往機場至少需要三十分鐘。

examples.en: The bus ride to the MRT station takes ten minutes at most.
examples.zh: 搭公車去捷運站至多只要十分鐘。

examples.en: The concert tickets will cost at most five hundred dollars for students.
examples.zh: 學生門票至多只需花費五百元。

examples.en: The quick oral quiz consists of five questions at most.
examples.zh: 這次隨堂口頭小考至多只有五道題目。

examples.en: We have learned one thousand practical vocabulary words so far!
examples.zh: 到目前為止我們已經學了一千個實用單字！

examples.en: How is your new semester going so far? — So far, so good!
examples.zh: 你新學期到目前為止過得如何？— 目前為止，一切都很好！

examples.en: So far, the company has raised millions of dollars for ocean cleanup projects.
examples.zh: 迄今為止，該公司已為海洋清理專案募集了數百萬美元。

examples.en: Wishing you all the best on your upcoming English exam!
examples.zh: 祝你即將到來的英語考試一切順利！

examples.en: We said goodbye and wished each other all the best for the future.
examples.zh: 我們道別並互相祝福彼此未來萬事勝意、一切順遂。

examples.en: Send this festive card to convey our warmest congratulations and all the best.
examples.zh: 寄出這張賀卡以表達我們最熱烈的祝賀與最美好的祝福。

examples.en: Thank you for your dedication to learning English!
examples.zh: 感謝你對英語學習的投入與熱情！

examples.en: Thank you very much for taking the time to help me with my studies.
examples.zh: 非常感謝你撥空在課業上給予我寶貴的指導與協助。

examples.en: A heartfelt 'thank you' can brighten someone's entire day.
examples.zh: 一聲發自內心的「謝謝你」，能點亮某人一整天的心情。
